components.text: InkBottleItem does not hard-code a color. The bottle stores ink_type and ink_remaining; the pen resolves the custom ink registry while painting.

pages.text:
$(f:minecraft:uniform)INK_TYPE      -> gyromancy:mana_ink
INK_REMAINING  -> 64 charges by default
PenProperties  -> brush size / precision / speed
Paint effect   ->$(/f)

• Without a bottle, ink_type, or remaining charges, the pen returns no color and paints nothing.
• By default one charge is consumed per ten valid paint actions.
